card.name: Last word of table column headers
card.fires_on: The final word of a table's column header, just before the first row of table data begins. It appears in flattened dosing and interaction tables, for example 'Interval', 'Reaction', 'Class or Name', and 'Time'.

modes.label: Header end in dosing tables
modes.description: The last word of a column title in a dosing or schedule table, right before the data cells.
modes.example: Table 1. Recommended Dose and Schedule for IMLYGIC Treatment Treatment I nter<<val>> Maximum I njection V olume per

modes.label: Header end in other tables
modes.description: The last word of a header cell in an interaction or dose-reduction table.
modes.example: Table 2: Dose Reductions for Evaluation of Creatinine Clearance CrCl = Creatinine clearance Creatinine<< Clearance>> Result Before Next Cycle Cisplatin

modes.label: Numeric table cells
modes.description: A closing bracket or space inside a numeric table cell, at the edge of a cell.

card.writes: It promotes long runs of blank lines, which suggests a table-like break in layout, and it suppresses code-like fragments.
card.plain: It marks the point where a table's heading row ends and the table's contents begin.
